mapper.sql: knowledge_file_id, document_uuid, original_filename, content_type, file_size, original_sha256, converted_sha256, storage_type, original_file_path, original_storage_status, markdown_file_path, convert_status, index_status, chunk_count, error_message, error_stage, created_at, converted_at, indexed_at, deleted_at, deletion_status, deletion_failed_stage, deletion_error_message, deletion_started_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_file (document_uuid, original_filename, content_type, file_size, original_sha256, converted_sha256, storage_type, original_file_path, original_storage_status, markdown_file_path, convert_status, index_status, chunk_count, error_message, error_stage, created_at, converted_at, indexed_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{documentUuid}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{originalSha256}, #{convertedSha256}, #{storageType}, #{originalFilePath}, #{originalStorageStatus}, #{markdownFilePath}, #{convertStatus}, #{indexStatus}, #{chunkCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{errorStage}, #{createdAt}, #{convertedAt}, #{indexedAt}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_file WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM knowledge_file WHERE knowledge_file_id IN
#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_file SET original_file_path = #{originalFilePath}, original_sha256 = #{originalSha256}, storage_type = #{storageType}, original_storage_status = 'STORED' WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL

UPDATE knowledge_file SET original_storage_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, error_stage = 'UPLOAD' WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL

UPDATE knowledge_file SET convert_status = 'CONVERTING', error_message = NULL, error_stage = NULL WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND convert_status IN ('UPLOADED', 'FAILED') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL

UPDATE knowledge_file SET convert_status = 'CONVERTED', markdown_file_path = #{markdownFilePath}, converted_sha256 = #{convertedSha256}, converted_at = #{convertedAt}, error_message = NULL, error_stage = NULL WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND convert_status = 'CONVERTING' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL

UPDATE knowledge_file SET index_status = 'VECTORIZING', error_message = NULL, error_stage = NULL WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND convert_status = 'CONVERTED' AND index_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'VECTORIZED') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL

UPDATE knowledge_file SET index_status = 'VECTORIZED', chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, indexed_at = #{indexedAt}, error_message = NULL, error_stage = NULL WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND index_status = 'VECTORIZING' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL
UPDATE knowledge_file SET convert_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, error_stage = 'CONVERT' WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL
UPDATE knowledge_file SET index_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, error_stage = 'VECTORIZE' WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL

UPDATE knowledge_file SET error_stage = CASE WHEN original_storage_status = 'STORING' THEN 'UPLOAD' WHEN convert_status = 'CONVERTING' THEN 'CONVERT' ELSE 'VECTORIZE' END, error_message = #{errorMessage}, original_storage_status = CASE WHEN original_storage_status = 'STORING' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE original_storage_status END, chunk_count = CASE WHEN convert_status = 'CONVERTING' OR index_status = 'VECTORIZING' THEN NULL ELSE chunk_count END, indexed_at = CASE WHEN convert_status = 'CONVERTING' OR index_status = 'VECTORIZING' THEN NULL ELSE indexed_at END, index_status = CASE WHEN convert_status = 'CONVERTING' OR index_status = 'VECTORIZING' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE index_status END, convert_status = CASE WHEN convert_status = 'CONVERTING' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE convert_status END WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL AND (original_storage_status = 'STORING' OR convert_status = 'CONVERTING' OR index_status = 'VECTORIZING')

UPDATE knowledge_file SET index_status = 'FAILED', chunk_count = NULL, indexed_at = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, error_stage = 'VECTORIZE' WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND convert_status = 'CONVERTED' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status IS NULL

UPDATE knowledge_file SET deletion_status = 'DELETING', deletion_failed_stage = NULL, deletion_error_message = NULL, deletion_started_at = #{startedAt} WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (original_storage_status IS NULL OR original_storage_status <> 'STORING') AND (convert_status IS NULL OR convert_status <> 'CONVERTING') AND (index_status IS NULL OR index_status <> 'VECTORIZING') AND (deletion_status IS NULL OR deletion_status = 'FAILED' OR (deletion_status = 'DELETING' AND deletion_started_at < #{staleBefore}))

UPDATE knowledge_file SET deletion_status = 'DELETED', deletion_failed_stage = NULL, deletion_error_message = NULL, deletion_started_at = NULL WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND (deletion_status IS NULL OR deletion_status = 'DELETING' OR deletion_status = 'FAILED')

UPDATE knowledge_file SET deletion_status = 'FAILED', deletion_failed_stage = 'PROCESS_RESTART', deletion_error_message = '后端进程重启，自动续删', deletion_started_at = NULL WHERE document_uuid = #{documentUuid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deletion_status = 'DELETING'
